answer: Sybil resistance follows from decaying, evidence-based trust: reputation has an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to maintain influence. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization gives freshly spawned identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; names such as comet, river, or walnut create no trust by themselves. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed reputation, leaving new sybils unable to reach the consensus threshold.
